item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish medister sausage with brown gravy, potatoes and cabbage salad. Served with pickled cucumber and lingonberries on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Taiwanese San Bei Ji, three cup chicken, with jasmine rice and sautéed bok choy. Served with chilli sauce and a crisp Asian cucumber salad. GREEN DISH: Dish Taiwanese San Bei Ji with tofu, jasmine rice and sautéed bok choy. Served with chilli sauce and a crisp Asian cucumber salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Salsiccia and spiced chorizo in a light summer ragout with soft, creamy polenta and baked cherry tomatoes tossed in herb pesto. (1+10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Spiced beluga lentils with Mediterranean flavours as a ragout, with soft, creamy polenta and baked cherry tomatoes in herb pesto. (10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Linguine with lobster and blue mussel bisque, steamed vegetables and butter-toasted sourdough bread. Topped with a fennel and parsley salad. (1+3+5+6+13+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Linguine in a deep, rich tomato sauce with steamed vegetables and butter-toasted sourdough bread. Topped with a fennel and parsley salad. (1+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Chicken Danoise with lightly roasted new potatoes and silky cream sauce, topped with fresh pea shoots. Served with a salad of radishes and peas in classic Danish dressing, rhubarb compote and cucumber salad. (6+11) GREEN DISH: Dish Hay-baked celeriac with new potatoes and silky cream sauce, topped with fresh pea shoots. Served with a salad of radishes and peas in classic Danish dressing, rhubarb compote and cucumber salad. The dish is vegan. (6+11)
